description: Dana Whitfield sends a message to Marcus Bell asking him to confirm the hall is held for the 14th.
Dana Whitfield sends a follow-up message to Marcus Bell: 'Hi Marcus, just checking in on my earlier message about the hall for the 14th. Could you confirm if it's still held? Thanks, Dana.'
Marcus Bell's phone receives Dana Whitfield's follow-up message, which is now in his message inbox.
Dana's follow-up message arrives on Marcus's phone.
Marcus Bell sees the notification of Dana's follow-up message on his phone but does not open it.
Dana Whitfield opens her list of potential venues and starts sending inquiries about availability for the 14th.
Dana Whitfield sends an inquiry to the first venue on her list, asking about availability for the 14th.
Dana Whitfield sends an inquiry to the second venue on her list, asking about availability for the 14th.
Dana opens her email and sees no new replies from the venues.
Dana Whitfield sends an inquiry to the third venue on her list, asking about availability for the 14th.
Dana Whitfield's inquiry to the third venue is sent.
Dana Whitfield sends an inquiry to the fourth venue on her list, asking about availability for the 14th.
Dana Whitfield opens her email inbox and sees no new replies from any of the four venues she contacted.
